# V2.2.7

**Slash commands right away, and the last native dropdowns.** The `/` menu now works the moment a saved session opens, and the remaining plain system dropdowns follow the skins. Everything from [2.2.6](https://github.com/Master0fFate/pi-fategui/releases/tag/v2.2.6) is included.

## `/` works before the first message

A saved session opens without starting Pi until you send something, and until then the `/` menu stayed empty. Now `/login`, `/logout`, `/compact` and `/goalmax` are always listed, and skills, prompt templates and extension commands come from any running session of the same project, or from the last list seen for it. Right after Fate UI starts, before any session in the project has run, only the built-in commands are listed.

## Every dropdown follows the skin

These used the operating system's plain dropdown and now use the skinned one in Default, Angelcore and M3 Expressive:

- **Session**, **Model** and **Thinking** in the web workspace header.
- **Device preset** in the browser's device toolbar. The browser page steps aside while its list is open, so the list is never hidden behind the page.
- **Requested permission** in the web control panel.
- **Status** of a GoalMax task.
